seo__search_description: Confidential, one-on-one counselling at Oakdene House for people affected by addiction and related challenges. Free. Fairfield, Western Sydney.
hero__intro: Confidential, one-on-one counselling for people affected by addiction and related challenges.
overview__text: Oakdene House offers individual counselling for people affected by addiction and related challenges. Counselling provides a confidential space to talk openly, understand what is happening and work toward realistic next steps. **Our counsellors specialise in gambling and alcohol dependency, alongside support for related life challenges.**
overview__text_2: All counselling sessions are free of charge.
overview__text_3: We aim to provide counselling that is respectful, practical and responsive to the person in front of us. Support is shaped around individual needs, not a fixed script.
what_to_expect__heading: Counselling with you, not at you
what_to_expect__text: Your counsellor takes time to understand your situation before suggesting anything.
what_to_expect__text_2: Everything you share stays private. Confidentiality is fundamental to our practice.
what_to_expect__text_3: Support is focused on realistic next steps and tangible progress — not just insight.
what_to_expect__text_4: You will not be judged for your choices or circumstances. We start from where you are.
cta__heading: Want to arrange a counselling session?
data__supports: Support during difficult periods of transition or stress
